title: Learning Materials Properties from Scarce Labels and Unlabeled Crystals
abstract: arXiv:2608.30682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning materials properties from scarce labels and unlabeled crystals is a central challenge for data-driven materials discovery. We present SemiMat, a controlled benchmark for semi-supervised materials property regression, and MatRank, a reliability-weighted objective for continuous pseudo-label uncertainty. SemiMat fixes labeled and unlabeled crystal inputs, graph-backbone interfaces, validation-only checkpoint selection, held-out test reporting, normalized MAE (NMAE), and method-rank summaries across six scarce-label tasks, four graph backbones, and five predefined split runs. MatRank builds pseudo-targets from labeled anchors, weights them by local reliability and weak-prediction agreement, trains weak and strong graph views consistently, and adds ranking signals so that unlabeled crystals shape both values and candidate order. translated_title: 从稀缺标签与未标注晶体中学习材料性质
translated_abstract: 从稀缺标签与未标注晶体中学习材料性质是数据驱动材料发现的核心挑战。我们提出了SemiMat——一个用于半监督材料性质回归的受控基准，以及MatRank——一种针对连续伪标签不确定性的可靠性加权目标函数。SemiMat固定了有标签与无标签晶体输入、图骨干网络接口、仅基于验证集的检查点选择、留出测试集报告、归一化平均绝对误差（NMAE），以及在六个稀缺标签任务、四个图骨干网络和五个预定义数据划分运行上的方法排名汇总。MatRank从有标签锚点构建伪目标，依据局部可靠性与弱预测一致性对其进行加权，一致地训练弱图视图与强图视图，并引入排序信号，使未标注晶体同时影响数值预测与候选排序。在保留的24个骨干-任务模块上，单一固定的MatRank目标取得了最低的总体……
tldr: 该论文提出了半监督材料性质回归基准SemiMat与可靠性加权的伪标签目标MatRank，通过充分利用未标注晶体数据，在标签稀缺条件下显著提升了材料性质预测性能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SemiMat, a controlled benchmark for semi-supervised materials property regression, and MatRank, a reliability-weighted pseudo-label objective, demonstrating that leveraging unlabeled crystals substantially improves property prediction under scarce labels.
